en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Salih Bin Uqba, from Abu Haroun Al Makfouf who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘O Abu Haroun! The Iqamah is from the Salāt. So when you establish it, so neither speak nor gesture with your hands’.
en.sarwar: 20. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Salih ibn ‘Uqbah from abu Harun al-Makfuf who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘O abu Harun, ‘Iqamah is part of Salah (prayer). When you say it do not speak or point with your hands.’”
